prompts.title: Audit a repository for reusable components
prompts.text: Use the repository-auditor skill to inventory my repository's architecture, dependencies, reusable parts, licenses and risks. Provide an evidence-linked extraction shortlist. Make no changes yet.

prompts.title: Check a PR for regressions
prompts.text: Use repository-auditor to compare this PR with main, identify broken routes, duplicated components and missing tests. Prioritize severity and cite file paths. Do not merge.
